instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Environmental conservation foundation managing 15 protected area and habitat restoration projects covering 25,000 hectares. Blend of scientific research, community engagement, and advocacy. Annual budget of €4M from grants and individual donations. Seeking to implement satellite-based deforestation monitoring and AI-assisted biodiversity species identification from camera trap images. Multi-department organization with formalized budgets, quarterly business reviews, and a dedicated strategy function. We have invested in core systems (ERP, CRM, HRIS) but these are not always well-integrated. Innovation is a standing agenda item at board level with annual investment allocated, but execution velocity varies across business units.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. The implementation was well-planned with dedicated project management and training. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring.
answers.strategicGoals: We are the incumbent market leader but face increasing pressure from 2 well-funded new entrants who are undercutting our pricing and offering a more modern customer experience. Our priority is defending our installed base — reducing churn, strengthening switching costs, and matching the digital experience our competitors offer without triggering a destructive price war.
answers.teamSize: We have a dedicated innovation squad of 11 people — 4 engineers, 1 data scientist, 1 UX designer, 1 product manager, and a part-time business analyst. This team operates with its own sprint cadence separate from the core product teams and has an allocated annual innovation budget. They report progress quarterly to the executive committee.

input.changes_since_last: Transitioning from founder-led to professional management. Hired 8 senior leaders. Strategic planning process being formalized.

opportunities.title: Automated Donor Journey Mapping and Retention Loop
opportunities.rationale: The primary market defense strategy requires strengthening the donor experience to reduce churn. By integrating marketing automation with the existing CRM, Nova can move beyond reactive data entry and proactively identify at-risk donors, thereby increasing switching costs.

first_actions: Conduct comprehensive mapping of the full donor lifecycle (donation -> engagement -> retention).
Pilot a predictive churn model using historical donation behavior and communication frequency.
Integrate AI-assisted lead scoring into the CRM for real-time marketing campaign adjustments.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in annual donor churn rate by 10% within 12 months.
milestones: Completed donor journey map and persona definition (Q1).
Predictive model validated with historical data (Q2).

opportunities.title: Scaling AI-Driven Geospatial Impact Monitoring
opportunities.rationale: Nova possesses specialized technical talent (data science, engineering) that can be leveraged to move beyond basic monitoring. Scaling this capability validates the technology investment and strengthens scientific credibility against competitors.

first_actions: Establish standardized protocols for field data intake (camera traps, satellite imagery).
Run a proof-of-concept pilot focusing on a single high-priority habitat area to refine the AI model accuracy.
Develop an internal API layer to feed validated biodiversity data directly into reporting dashboards.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in manual effort required for species identification by 40% per quarter.
milestones: Data intake pipeline finalized and tested (Q1).
Pilot model deployed with acceptable accuracy thresholds (Q2).
Internal dashboard operationalized for executive use (Q3).

next_steps.action: Establish a dedicated Integration Roadmap owner to prioritize and execute API connections between ERP, CRM, and the new data science tools.
Conduct a formal Data Governance and Privacy review (especially regarding donor/field data) to ensure compliance with evolving data protection regulations.
Formalize roles and governance structures between the Innovation Squad and core business units to ensure sustained execution velocity.

key_weaknesses: Systemic integration gaps (Core systems are functional but operate in silos, reducing holistic data view).
Process dependency on key personnel; formalizing repeatable processes across business units is still nascent.
Translating high-level technical capacity into consistent, field-deployed operational impact.

improvements: Formalization of strategic planning and dedicated annual innovation budget (Board level support).
Significant increase in digital maturity via successful implementation of core systems (CRM deployment success).
Establishment of a fully staffed, semi-autonomous Innovation Squad.
persistent_gaps: Data silos remain the primary bottleneck, hindering cross-functional analysis.
Operationalizing new tech (AI/Geospatial) requires significant standardization of input data and field protocols.
Integration governance needs to move from 'ad hoc' to structured project management.
achieved_milestones: Successful deployment and utilization of the CRM system, significantly improving lead tracking efficiency.
The innovation function is now a standing agenda item at the board level.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Shift from foundational process establishment (hiring/formalizing structure) to advanced execution and market defense. The focus has evolved from merely 'having systems' to aggressively optimizing data flow (CXM) and scaling technical capability (AI Geospatial).
